title: Transfer learning forecasts eruptions at volcanoes without their own training data
summary: A transfer machine-learning approach identified seismic eruption precursors shared across volcanoes, using data from 41 eruptions at 24 volcanoes over 73 years. Tested without data from the target volcano, it forecast eruptions with accuracy comparable to direct training on the target and above seismic-amplitude benchmarks. The authors interpret this as ergodicity of eruption precursors; the analysis is retrospective, based on few eruptions, and the abstract gives no numbers.
ai_technology: Transfer machine learning on seismic data to identify cross-volcano eruption precursors

evidence.tested: Out-of-sample forecasting at held-out volcanoes using archived seismic records.
evidence.unknown: Real-time forecasting skill and numeric performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Transfer learning identified precursors that generalize to unobserved volcanoes.
